64-500-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
64-500-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Warden of the Eye and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-5332--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carmen ability, gaining 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

147-3890-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-3890-8095.description:
Cast Unearth by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-6495-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6495-7396.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.
586-864-3125-6495-7396.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4050-7918.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

280-1479-7885.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

301-345-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1874-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

129-1409-3480-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

220-1203.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
220-1203.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

1563-1879-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-1879-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-1879-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

489-1020-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-2919-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2893-3875-6168-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2173-3518-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

640-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4215-5147-6730.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
4215-5147-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

1020-2866-6289-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1770-2232-6470.notablePrerequisites: You control and own a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana.
1770-2232-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve the Iridescent Tiger triggers, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Cast the creature returned to your hand by paying its mana cost. 
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing with the second trigger.
Repeat.

372-2556-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2556-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1461-4050-4078-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-5070.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Wurmcoil Engine's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers twice, causing you to gain life equal to the Wurms' combined toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

710-5256-5617.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

678-2034-2348-2882-3819.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2034-2348-2882-3819.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Nature's Revolt and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land, adding {C}{C}.
When the land dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the land to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put the land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

36-3232-4050-4763.description:
Cast Mogg War Marshal by paying {1}{R}.
Mogg War Marshal enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Obsidian Battle-Axe.
Resolve Obsidian Battle-Axe's trigger, attaching it to Mogg War Marshal.
Resolve Mogg War Marshal's trigger, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Goblin token and Mogg War Marshall, adding {R}{R}.
Mogg War Marshall dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Mogg War Marshal's trigger, creating another 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Mogg War Marshal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times to add infinite mana.

1283-2011-3049-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Sophina do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other nontoken creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1283-2011-3049-4659.description:
Declare Najeela, Sophina, and at least one other nontoken creature as attackers.
Sophina and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Sophina trigger, creating at least three Clue artifact tokens.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Clue tokens, adding {6}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2233-3569.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2034-2233-3569.description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying {1}{G}.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1021-2167-3664.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1021-2167-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1684-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-5231.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create an Elemental token with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
